permanent_replay.atomicity: Replay in one transaction with FK/trigger checks active. Every INSERT must affect exactly its captured row count. No dynamic table identifiers and no conflict suppression. Roll back on any mismatch.
permanent_replay.membership: Organization INSERT triggers create group_memberships. Require exact expected group/org keys and exact count, then restore only captured created_at using the fixed statement below; affected count must equal2.
